# Samvora Studio

> Samvora Studio is a one-stop creative studio offering video editing, AI-generated UGC video, website design, and YouTube channel strategy for creators and brands.

Samvora Studio is a small, founder-led studio (not an agency) based remotely and serving clients worldwide, with particular reach in Nigeria. Clients work directly with the person doing the work — no account managers or handoffs between departments. Typical turnaround is 24–72 hours for a single video edit.

## Services

- **Video Editing** — Long-form YouTube edits, Shorts, Reels, and TikTok cutdowns, with captions, motion graphics, color correction, and sound design. Starting at $150/video, 24–72 hour turnaround.
- **AI UGC Video** — AI-generated, avatar-led video ads in a testimonial or product-demo style, built without booking a camera crew or talent. Starting at $250/video, 2–4 day turnaround.
- **Website Design** — Custom, mobile-responsive, conversion-focused websites with basic SEO built in from launch. Starting at $600/site, 1–2 week turnaround.
- **YouTube Channel Strategy** — Channel audits, keyword and title research, thumbnail design and testing, upload scheduling, and monthly performance review. Starting at $400/month.

## Pricing tiers

- **Rough Cut** ($150/video) — pay-as-you-go video editing.
- **Final Cut** ($900/month) — weekly editing plus YouTube optimization; most popular plan.
- **Director's Cut** (custom pricing) — all four services bundled with a dedicated point of contact.
